fixtures.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. ADDSIZE. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 A PIC 9 VALUE 9. 01 B PIC 9 VALUE 9. 01 C PIC 9. PROCEDURE DIVISION. ADD A B GIVING C ON SIZE ERROR DISPLAY 'SIZE' NOT ON SIZE ERROR DISPLAY 'BAD' END-ADD. STOP RUN.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. CALLERR. PROCEDURE DIVISION. CALL 'MISSING' ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY 'CALL-ERR' NOT ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY 'BAD' END-CALL. STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. READEOF. ENVIRONMENT DIVISION. INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION. FILE-CONTROL. SELECT INPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO INPUTDD ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL. DATA DIVISION. FILE SECTION. FD INPUT-FILE. 01 INPUT-REC PIC X. PROCEDURE DIVISION. READ INPUT-FILE INTO INPUT-REC AT END DISPLAY 'EOF' NOT AT END DISPLAY 'BAD' END-READ. STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. STARTERR. ENVIRONMENT DIVISION. INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION. FILE-CONTROL. SELECT INPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO INPUTDD ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED RECORD KEY IS KEY-X FILE STATUS IS STATUS-X. DATA DIVISION. FILE SECTION. FD INPUT-FILE. 01 INPUT-REC. 05 KEY-X PIC X VALUE 'Z'. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 STATUS-X PIC XX. PROCEDURE DIVISION. START INPUT-FILE KEY IS EQUAL TO KEY-X INVALID KEY DISPLAY 'INVALID' NOT INVALID KEY DISPLAY 'BAD' END-START. STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. STRINGERR. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 SOURCE-X PIC X(3) VALUE 'ABC'. 01 TARGET-X PIC X. PROCEDURE DIVISION. STRING SOURCE-X DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO TARGET-X ON OVERFLOW DISPLAY 'OVER' NOT ON OVERFLOW DISPLAY 'BAD' END-STRING. STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. UNSTRINGERR. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 SOURCE-X PIC X(3) VALUE 'A B'. 01 TARGET-X PIC X. PROCEDURE DIVISION. UNSTRING SOURCE-X DELIMITED BY SPACE INTO TARGET-X ON OVERFLOW DISPLAY 'OVER' NOT ON OVERFLOW DISPLAY 'BAD' END-UNSTRING. STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. JSONERR. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 SOURCE-X PIC X(3) VALUE 'BAD'. 01 TARGET-X PIC X. PROCEDURE DIVISION. JSON PARSE SOURCE-X INTO TARGET-X ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY 'JSON-ERR' NOT ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY 'BAD' END-JSON. STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. INVOKEERR. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 RECEIVER OBJECT REFERENCE CUSTOMER. PROCEDURE DIVISION. INVOKE RECEIVER 'RUN' ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY 'INVOKE-ERR' NOT ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY 'BAD' END-INVOKE. STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. XMLERR. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 SOURCE-X PIC X(3) VALUE 'BAD'. 01 TARGET-X PIC X. PROCEDURE DIVISION. XML PARSE SOURCE-X INTO TARGET-X ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY 'XML-ERR' NOT ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY 'BAD' END-XML. STOP RUN.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. DYNLIMIT. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 DYN-X PIC X DYNAMIC LENGTH LIMIT IS 2. PROCEDURE DIVISION. MOVE 'TOO' TO DYN-X. STOP RUN.
